entries.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
entries.summary: Samuel (hamstring) is not expected to practice Wednesday, Cam Inman of Bay Area News Group reports.

entries.name: Elijah Arroyo
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald confirmed with reporters Monday that Arroyo will miss "significant time" due to a shoulder injury that he picked up during Thursday's 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Monangai (toe/thumb) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Patriots.

entries.name: Terry McLaurin
entries.summary: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn announced Monday that McLaurin has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee following an MRI and will miss the rest of the season.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Charbonnet (knee) was a full participant at Wednesday's practice, Corbin K. Smith of EmeraldCitySpectrum.com reports.

entries.name: Marcus Mariota
entries.summary: doubtful

entries.name: Adonai Mitchell
entries.summary: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Mitchell (finger) will be a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.

entries.name: Alvin Kamara
entries.summary: Kamara (back) practiced in a limited capacity Wednesday, Katherine Terrell of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Anthony Gould
entries.summary: Gould won't return to Sunday's game against the Titans after being diagnosed with a concussion, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Ashton Dulin
entries.summary: Dulin (hamstring) was a limited participant at the Colts' practice Wednesday.

entries.name: Baker Mayfield
entries.summary: Mayfield (right thumb) was a full practice participant Wednesday, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

entries.name: Ben Skowronek
entries.summary: Skowronek (calf) did not practice Wednesday, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

entries.name: Bo Melton
entries.summary: Melton (back) was a limited participant in Wednesday's walkthrough practice, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Breece Hall
entries.summary: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Hall (quadriceps) won't practice Wednesday but hasn't been ruled out from playing Sunday versus the Dolphins, Al Iannazzone of Newsday reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (quadriceps) was active but didn't play any snaps Sunday in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.

entries.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
entries.summary: Robinson (hamstring) was a limited participant during Wednesday's practice, Daniel Flick of The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports.

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Bowers was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice due to hamstring and calf injuries.

entries.name: Bucky Irving
entries.summary: Irving (illness) was back at practice Thursday, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: Douglas (ankle) was a limited practice participant Wednesday and said afterward that his status is day-to-day heading into Sunday's game against the Jets, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Calvin Ridley
entries.summary: Ridley (hip) was a limited participant in practice Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site  reports.

entries.name: Carson Beck
entries.summary: Beck (back) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Christian Watson
entries.summary: Head coach Matt LaFleur said Thursday that the team has no concern regarding Watson's (ankle) availability for Sunday's game against the Lions, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: CJ Donaldson
entries.summary: Donaldson (shoulder) was listed as a limited practice participant Wednesday, Katherine Terrell of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Dalton Schultz
entries.summary: Schultz (qaudriceps) returned to practice Thursday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: David Montgomery
entries.summary: Montgomery (groin) isn't practicing Wednesday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Denzel Boston
entries.summary: Boston (foot) was a limited participant at Wednesday's practice, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Drew Lock
entries.summary: Lock (elbow) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Corbin K. Smith of EmeraldCitySpectrum.com reports.

entries.name: Drew Ogletree
entries.summary: Ogletree (ankle) did not participate at the Colts' practice Wednesday.

entries.name: Emeka Egbuka
entries.summary: Egbuka (concussion/foot) was working on the side with a trainer at Thursday's practice, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

entries.name: Jaylen Waddle
entries.summary: Waddle was limited at Wednesday's practice due to a chest injury, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

entries.name: Jaylen Wright
entries.summary: Wright (foot) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: The Cardinals expect to remain without Love (ankle) for Sunday's game against the Broncos, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports Thursday.

entries.name: Jordan Love
entries.summary: Love was listed as a limited participant on Wednesday's practice estimate due to a back injury, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Justin Jefferson
entries.summary: Jefferson (ankle) was limited at Wednesday's practice.

entries.name: KaVontae Turpin
entries.summary: Turpin (ribs) is expected to miss the team's Week 7 matchup with the Eagles, Joe Hoyt of The Dallas Morning News reports.

entries.name: KC Concepcion
entries.summary: Concepcion (calf, quad) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.

entries.name: Kene Nwangwu
entries.summary: Nwangwu (knee) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey won't return to Sunday's game at Kansas City due to a concussion.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: Jackson (ankle) was listed as a  limited participant Wednesday.

entries.name: Matt Hibner
entries.summary: Hibner (hand) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.

entries.name: Matthew Golden

entries.name: Mike Evans

entries.name: Mike Washington Jr.

entries.name: Olamide Zaccheaus

entries.name: Quinshon Judkins

entries.name: Rashid Shaheed

entries.name: Rashod Bateman

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: Dowdle was listed as a limited participant for Wednesday's practice due to a knee injury, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: Barkley (hamstring) is expected to practice Thursday and "is in line to play Monday against the Cowboys," Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Savion Williams
entries.summary: Williams (ankle) was listed as a limited participant on Wednesday's estimated injury report, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: T.J. Hockenson
entries.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said that Hockenson (concussion) is expected to practice Wednesday, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Theo Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson (neck) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

entries.name: Travis Kelce

entries.name: Tre' Harris
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Tyler Warren

entries.name: Will Kacmarek
entries.summary: Kacmarek (hamstring) was a limited participant at the Dolphins' practice Wednesday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce (heel) won't have his 21-day practice window opened in Week 7, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.

entries.name: Carter Runyon

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: Thornton (hamstring) was a full participant at practice Wednesday.

entries.name: Dylan Sampson
entries.summary: Browns head coach Todd Monken said that he's optimistic that Sampson (knee) will be activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Titans, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Eli Stowers
entries.summary: The Eagles have downgraded Stowers (quadriceps) to out for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

entries.name: Grant Calcaterra
entries.summary: The Eagles downgraded Calcaterra (back) to out Saturday for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

entries.name: Jadarian Price
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Price "should be looking at a sooner rather than later return after" the Seahawks' next game in Week 7, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jalen Hurts
entries.summary: Hurts (calf) is expected to be held out of football activities for multiple months and miss the rest of the season after new imaging over the weekend revealed several blood clots in his lungs, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Lane
entries.summary: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

entries.name: Jonah Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) was a full participant at Wednesday's practice.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (core) was seen jogging at practice Thursday, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports.

entries.name: Jordan Mason
entries.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said that Mason (thumb) is expected to practice Wednesday, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jordyn Tyson
entries.summary: Saints general manager Mickey Loomis said Tuesday that Tyson (hamstring) is "getting closer" but won't practice this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

entries.name: Josh Oliver
entries.summary: The Vikings placed Oliver (biceps) on injured reserve Tuesday, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Romeo Doubs
entries.summary: Doubs (shoulder) is hopeful to return after the Patriots' Week 11 bye and isn't expected to face a long-term absence, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Skyy Moore
entries.summary: The Packers placed Moore (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Tank Dell
entries.summary: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Dell (knee) is on track to return from injured reserve to make his season debut in Week 7 versus the Giants, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Tanner Hudson
entries.summary: Hudson (pectoral) was placed on injured reserve by the Bengals on Monday.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson

entries.name: Tom Kennedy
entries.summary: The Lions placed Kennedy (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Tyquan Thornton
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Thornton (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.
